title: Local correlated genus-one Gromov–Witten invariants over an elliptic curve
source_version: Official SIGMA 21 (2025) journal PDF and native TeX; acquired 2026-09-30; exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The author enumerates covers together with line-bundle solutions and their correlator torsor, computes the selected coefficient by isogeny arithmetic, then reconstructs all torsion coefficients using prime-power multiplicativity and a recursive relation. The arithmetic refinement and geometric covering count are both retained; the final divisor sum alone is not the problem.
author: Thomas Blomme; Francesca Carocci
